name: OpenSCAD import and export
description: Opens OpenSCAD scripts (.scad) as solid bodies, with a form for the script's settings, and writes your design out as an OpenSCAD script. It reads the language itself; it does not use OpenSCAD's code.
author: Sketchy

importers.label: OpenSCAD script
importers.description: Runs the script and adds the result as a body.

exporters.label: OpenSCAD script
exporters.description: Each body as a polyhedron module (a snapshot, not the feature timeline).
